# Neuvto WOS

> Mobile-first Workforce Operating System. Launching with Leave Management, expanding to attendance, payroll, performance, and learning.

Neuvto WOS replaces the legacy HRMS employees ignore with a mobile-first
platform designed for the whole workforce. The MVP module — Leave
Management — ships one-tap requests, multi-level approvals, real-time
balances, a team calendar, and a configurable policy engine.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product vision, Leave Management preview, roadmap, and demo request form.
